bundle.shortDescription: Your LLeMbas server in a window, with the agent on this computer
bundle.longDescription: LLeMbas Desktop opens your LLeMbas server's web UI in a window of its own and runs the LLeMbas CLI agent on this computer, so agent chats can work in your projects here without a terminal.
